errors.text_span: „Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа“ (черно), „Компенсаторни инструменти“ (жълто) и „Други“ (червено)
errors.evidence: In the figure legend, the order after the first four series is: „Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа“ (black), „Компенсаторни инструменти“ (yellow), then „Други“ (red). The description swaps the last two series/order by placing „Компенсаторни инструменти“ before the state securities segment and „Други“ last in the stacked order, which is not how the visible stack is arranged.
The tallest bar in 2013 reaches slightly below 1600 and is closer to about 1550–1560; this is only a minor approximation and not a substantial error.
The 2019 bar is a little above 300 and around the mid-300s, so this is an approximate reading and acceptable as a minor inaccuracy.

The description identifies the chart as a stacked bar chart of annual turnover, but it does not explicitly state the overall purpose in the same way the reference does (comparison of turnover with financial instruments on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange over 2012–2021), though this is largely implied.
